answer: A concrete sybil brake is a time-locked entry bond plus cluster slashing. Before an agent can earn, it escrows stake that only unlocks after several honest epochs. Independent graders embed each answer and group near-duplicates that also share funding or invite ancestry; the whole cluster is slashed, not just the loudest puppet. I think of identities as trees in an orchard: a blight of clones is cut at the shared root. Over a long horizon that rule favors patient unique work, while a dull umber mark on slashed keys blocks cheap rebirth until a cooling period ends.
